product_from_film: Promethee turns work sessions into points, rankings and social sharing.
explains_well: One character starts a session, gains rank, shares a session card and connects with others.
unclear: Activity detection and rewards are represented, but what counts as meaningful work is not explained.
scenario: Track a work session, gain XP, share a session and join a group.
product_clear_basis: Activity detection and Start session appear at 31–34 s; timer and leaderboard establish gamified work by 40 s.

lessons.keep: Follow the same person through start, reward, sharing and community.
try: For ReadnType, show one valid reading session becoming an ERS result, a share card and a peer challenge using real UI.
For a productivity film, test a shorter entry shot followed immediately by Start session, then retain the customized share-card payoff.
lessons.avoid: Using a long cinematic arrival before explaining the utility.
lessons.open: Reward validity, activity detection, continuous effect motion and all audio choices are unverified.

comparison.story: Invite the viewer into a character journey. → Introduce work as a shared game. → Move from observer to participant. → Start a tracked focus session. → Link continued work with rewards. → Add social contact and task rewards. → End the scored session. → Turn effort into a shareable card. → Show social response. → Make the online group physically present. → Close with community promise.
